solutions.heading: Solutions for traditional industries
solutions.intro: Every industry gets paid differently. Here is how Quick Come fits into the way you already trade.

items.name: Exporters
items.summary: Collect payment from overseas buyers without waiting on the banking system.
pains: International wires take days and are unpredictable
Some buyers struggle to send bank transfers from their country
Charges from intermediary banks reduce the amount received
items.solution: Issue payment requests in USDT or USDC. Buyers pay from a wallet or exchange account, and you see the payment as soon as it is confirmed on-chain.
benefits: Ship sooner once payment is confirmed

items.name: Manufacturers
items.summary: Get paid by distributors and overseas customers with clear, traceable records.
pains: Long payment cycles strain working capital
Uncertain arrival times make production planning harder
Matching incoming wires to orders is manual work
items.solution: Receive deposits and balance payments in stablecoins, each linked to an order reference, so your finance team can reconcile quickly.
benefits: Records ready for your finance team

items.name: Cross-border B2B traders
items.summary: One way to get paid across many countries and counterparties.
pains: Maintaining banking channels in many countries
Different payment methods for each counterparty
items.solution: Use stablecoins as a single collection method across counterparties, and discuss conversion and payout options with our sales team.

how.heading: How Quick Come works
how.intro: Getting started takes a few steps. Our team guides you through each one.

steps.title: Talk to us
steps.body: Book a demo and tell us about your business, your buyers and how you get paid today.

steps.title: Business verification
steps.body: Complete KYB: company documents, ownership information and the nature of your business.

steps.title: Set up your account
steps.body: We configure your account, supported assets and networks, and the team members who can access it.

steps.title: Request payment
steps.body: Send your buyer a payment request with the amount, asset, network and order reference.

steps.title: Receive and reconcile
steps.body: Incoming payments are screened, confirmed on-chain and recorded against the order.

steps.title: Settle
steps.body: Hold funds in stablecoins, or arrange conversion and payout. Fiat settlement terms are agreed with our sales team.

how.assetsNote: The exact list of supported networks is confirmed during onboarding.
how.fiatBody: Conversion to local currency, payout methods, pricing and timelines depend on your jurisdiction and business profile. Please contact sales to discuss your needs.

security.heading: Security & Compliance
security.intro: Traditional businesses rightly ask hard questions about digital assets. Here is how we approach them.

sections.title: Business verification (KYB)
sections.body: Every business is verified before its account is activated. We review company registration, ownership and the nature of the business.

sections.title: Transaction screening
sections.body: Incoming payments are screened against risk indicators. Payments that raise concerns may be held for review.

sections.title: Account security
sections.body: Accounts support two-factor authentication and role-based access, so each team member only sees what they need.

sections.title: Clear records
sections.body: Every payment is linked to an on-chain transaction ID and an order reference, giving you an auditable trail.

riskItems: Stablecoins are digital assets and are not bank deposits.
The value of a stablecoin may deviate from its reference currency.
Blockchain transactions are generally irreversible once confirmed. Sending funds to a wrong address or network can result in permanent loss.
Services are subject to the laws of your jurisdiction and to successful completion of our onboarding checks.
security.entityBody: Quick Come services are provided by Quick Come. Services are not offered to residents or entities in Mainland China.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: This website is operated by Quick Come ("we", "us"). For privacy questions, contact privacy@quickcomepay.com.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: When you submit the demo request form, we collect the information you provide: name, company, work email, country or region, industry, and optionally your collection volume, phone number and message. We also record your IP address, browser user agent and the time of submission to protect the form against abuse.

sections.title: Business onboarding (KYB)
sections.body: If you become a business client, we send you a personal onboarding link. Through it we collect the information needed to verify your business and meet our compliance obligations: company details and documents, details of directors, beneficial owners and authorised signatories (including dates of birth, nationality, residential address, passport details and copies, proof of address and politically exposed person status), wallet ownership declarations, and your signature together with the time, IP address and browser used to sign. This information is encrypted in storage and is accessible only to authorised Quick Come staff. It is stored with our hosting and storage providers (Vercel and Upstash, Singapore region) and is used only for onboarding, compliance and our business relationship. Applications that are not approved are deleted after 1 year; for approved clients, records are kept for 5 years after the business relationship ends, unless the law requires otherwise.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: We use this information only to respond to your request, to discuss our services with you, and to prevent spam and abuse. We do not sell your information.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: This website does not use advertising cookies or third-party analytics. If this changes, we will update this policy first.

sections.title: Sharing
sections.body: Your information is processed by our email service provider to deliver your request to our team. We may disclose information where required by law.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: We keep form submissions for as long as needed to handle your request and our business relationship, and delete them when no longer needed.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct or delete your information, or object to its processing. Contact privacy@quickcomepay.com to make a request.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update this policy. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.

sections.title: About these terms
sections.body: These terms apply to your use of the Quick Come website. Our payment services are governed by separate agreements signed during onboarding.

sections.title: Information only
sections.body: Content on this website is for general information about our services. It is not investment, legal, tax or financial advice, and it is not an offer in any jurisdiction where such an offer would be unlawful.

sections.title: Eligibility
sections.body: Our services are available only to businesses that pass our verification checks and are located in jurisdictions we support. Services are not offered to residents or entities in Mainland China.

sections.title: Risks
sections.body: Digital assets involve risks, including value deviation from the reference currency and irreversible transactions. Please read the risk notice on our Security & Compliance page.

sections.title: Intellectual property

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: We provide this website "as is" and are not liable for decisions made based on its content, to the extent permitted by law.
